title: Build gate admits a definition native status reports as invalid
symptom: plan -> build succeeded with gate native:approved while native status reported approval_valid false
trigger: Approved change whose definition no longer matches its approval
expected: Entering build is refused and names the native next action (re-approve)
actual: Allowed: the gate compares summary.state only
steps: Approve a change, then change its scope
specsync change status <id> --json reports approval_valid false
impact: Implementation can start on a scope nobody approved in its current form
source: Review finding A, reproduced 2026-10-31 against main f19823d

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Fixed in 8075748 (fail-closed stage gates); regression TC-cli-0040 passed (observation tc-cli-0040-1793481644).
